fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck entrance on the W side of the property where the access road off CSX Way meets the yard - z20 satellite (fedex-15-gate-z20b) clearly shows a barrier across the truck lane, a pinch-point with lane markings, and 'NO PARKING' painted on the apron.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small detached structure with a distinctive orange/brown roof sits immediately beside the gate lane at the entrance pinch-point - a staffed guard booth (~1-2 vehicle footprint). remoteGs therefore false.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Trucks observed parked along the CSX Way shoulder outside the gate (fedex-15-gate-z20); paved apron width before the gate gives room to wait.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard between the gate and the dock aprons inside the fence provides a deep internal queue/holding area.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal driveway from the W gate runs a long, deep paved stretch into the yard before the dock aprons - room for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long NE-SW cross-dock building with continuous dock doors along BOTH long faces, trailers backed in along each side; estimated ~110 total - count approximate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yard on the E side with many marked rows of parked trailers without tractors; well over 50 stalls - dropYard true.
fieldNotes.railServed: A CSX rail line runs along the N edge of the property but is a through-line bordering the site; no spur enters the FedEx yard - railServed false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site is within the Charlotte NC metro in a dense multi-tenant industrial corridor (CSX intermodal area, NW Charlotte) flanked by other large warehouses - Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: FedEx occupies a single cross-dock building plus its drop yard; the separate white building to the NE is a different tenant.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One FedEx cross-dock building; confirmed by FedEx-branded trailers and a FedEx dropbox/mailbox in 2022 Street View along the access road.
